function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

## 题目

给定一个整数数组 nums 和一个整数目标值 target，请你在该数组中找出 和为目标值 target  的那 两个 整数，并返回它们的数组下标。

你可以假设每种输入只会对应一个答案。但是，数组中同一个元素在答案里不能重复出现。

你可以按任意顺序返回答案。

## 示例

示例 1：

输入：nums = [2,7,11,15], target = 9
输出：[0,1]
解释：因为 nums[0] + nums[1] == 9 ，返回 [0, 1] 。

示例 2：

输入：nums = [3,2,4], target = 6
输出：[1,2]

示例 3：

输入：nums = [3,3], target = 6
输出：[0,1]

## 提示

2 <= nums.length <= 104
-109 <= nums[i] <= 109
-109 <= target <= 109
只会存在一个有效答案

## 进阶

你可以想出一个时间复杂度小于 O(n2) 的算法吗？

## 解题思路

### 方法一：暴力枚举

最容易想到的方法是枚举数组中的每一个数 x，寻找数组中是否存在 target - x。

当我们使用遍历整个数组的方式寻找 target - x 时，需要注意到每一个位于 x 之前的元素都已经和 x 匹配过，因此不需要再进行匹配。而每一个元素不能被使用两次，所以我们只需要在 x 后面的元素中寻找 target - x。

#### 代码

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if nums[i] + nums[j] == target:
                    return [i, j]
        return []
```

#### 复杂度分析

- 时间复杂度：O(N^2)，其中 N 是数组中的元素数量。最坏情况下数组中任意两个数都要被匹配一次。
- 空间复杂度：O(1)。

### 方法二：哈希表

注意到方法一的时间复杂度较高的原因是寻找 target - x 的时间复杂度过高。因此，我们需要一种更优秀的方法，能够快速寻找数组中是否存在目标元素。如果存在，我们需要找出它的索引。

使用哈希表，可以将寻找 target - x 的时间复杂度降低到从 O(N) 降低到 O(1)。

这样我们创建一个哈希表，对于每一个 x，我们首先查询哈希表中是否存在 target - x，然后将 x 插入到哈希表中，即可保证不会让 x 和自己匹配。

#### 代码

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        hashtable = dict()
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            if target - num in hashtable:
                return [hashtable[target - num], i]
            hashtable[nums[i]] = i
        return []
```

#### 复杂度分析

- 时间复杂度：O(N)，其中 N 是数组中的元素数量。对于每一个元素 x，我们可以 O(1) 地寻找 target - x。
- 空间复杂度：O(N)，其中 N 是数组中的元素数量。主要为哈希表的开销。

## 总结

本题展示了两种不同的解题思路：暴力枚举和哈希表。暴力枚举虽然简单，但时间复杂度较高，不适合处理大规模数据。哈希表方法通过空间换时间，将时间复杂度降低到 O(N)，是一种更高效的解决方案。

## 题目

给定一个整数数组 nums 和一个整数目标值 target，请你在该数组中找出 和为目标值 target  的那 两个 整数，并返回它们的数组下标。

你可以假设每种输入只会对应一个答案。但是，数组中同一个元素在答案里不能重复出现。

你可以按任意顺序返回答案。

## 示例

示例 1：

输入：nums = [2,7,11,15], target = 9
输出：[0,1]
解释：因为 nums[0] + nums[1] == 9 ，返回 [0, 1] 。

示例 2：

输入：nums = [3,2,4], target = 6
输出：[1,2]

示例 3：

输入：nums = [3,3], target = 6
输出：[0,1]

## 提示

2 <= nums.length <= 104
-109 <= nums[i] <= 109
-109 <= target <= 109
只会存在一个有效答案

## 进阶

你可以想出一个时间复杂度小于 O(n2) 的算法吗？

## 解题思路

### 方法一：暴力枚举

最容易想到的方法是枚举数组中的每一个数 x，寻找数组中是否存在 target - x。

当我们使用遍历整个数组的方式寻找 target - x 时，需要注意到每一个位于 x 之前的元素都已经和 x 匹配过，因此不需要再进行匹配。而每一个元素不能被使用两次，所以我们只需要在 x 后面的元素中寻找 target - x。

#### 代码

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if nums[i] + nums[j] == target:
                    return [i, j]
        return []
```

#### 复杂度分析

- 时间复杂度：O(N^2)，其中 N 是数组中的元素数量。最坏情况下数组中任意两个数都要被匹配一次。
- 空间复杂度：O(1)。

### 方法二：哈希表

注意到方法一的时间复杂度较高的原因是寻找 target - x 的时间复杂度过高。因此，我们需要一种更优秀的方法，能够快速寻找数组中是否存在目标元素。如果存在，我们需要找出它的索引。

使用哈希表，可以将寻找 target - x 的时间复杂度降低到从 O(N) 降低到 O(1)。

这样我们创建一个哈希表，对于每一个 x，我们首先查询哈希表中是否存在 target - x，然后将 x 插入到哈希表中，即可保证不会让 x 和自己匹配。

#### 代码

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        hashtable = dict()
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            if target - num in hashtable:
                return [hashtable[target - num], i]
            hashtable[nums[i]] = i
        return []
```

#### 复杂度分析

- 时间复杂度：O(N)，其中 N 是数组中的元素数量。对于每一个元素 x，我们可以 O(1) 地寻找 target - x。
- 空间复杂度：O(N)，其中 N 是数组中的元素数量。主要为哈希表的开销。

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.
